description: bb plugins by Kalindu De Costa.

categories.description: Change what people see or do inside an open thread.

plugins.description: Expands thinking blocks in threads automatically and keeps streaming thinking scrolled into view. Toggle it from the thread header.
plugins.overview:
Watch an agent reason without clicking each thinking row open and scrolling inside it while the text streams.

## What you get

- The live **Thinking…** row at the bottom of a running thread opens by itself and stays scrolled to its newest line.
- Finished **Thought** rows open when they appear, including the ones inside an activity group once you open that group.
- Scroll up inside a thinking block to read earlier text and it stops following; scroll back to the bottom and it follows again.
- A block you collapse stays collapsed.
- A brain button in the thread header turns the plugin on or off, and so does the command **Follow Thinking: Toggle auto-expand and auto-scroll of thinking** in the command palette. Turning it off collapses the blocks it opened and leaves the ones you opened.

## How it works

The plugin runs in the bb window and works on the timeline bb already draws. It needs no account, settings or server state. The on/off choice is saved on each device and shared by every bb window there.

## Limits

bb has no plugin interface for timeline rows, so the plugin recognises thinking blocks by the markup that bb 0.46 draws. If a bb update changes that markup, the plugin stops doing anything until it is updated; the timeline itself keeps working.

plugins.description: Shows everything a thread's agent did as one flat, live, searchable log in the thread's side panel: messages, thinking, commands with output and exit codes, tool calls, diffs and subagents.
plugins.overview:
See everything an agent did in a thread without opening nested chat rows.

## What you get

- One flat side-panel log in bb's timeline order: your messages and steers, child reports, agent replies, thinking, commands, tool calls, file diffs and subagent steps.
- Timestamps, status, exit codes and duration beside each step. Replies appear in full, long output previews its first and last lines, failed commands and tools open by default, and `x` expands every row.
- Filters for Messages, Thinking, Tools and Errors, plus whole-session search. The log follows new output, including outputs that open up as they finish, until you scroll up or move to an older row; “↓ Latest” or `G` takes you back.
- Keyboard navigation (`j/k`, `n/N` for replies, `e/E` for errors), copy (`c`), a message link back to chat (`s`), and Mod+Shift+L to open the tab. The thread header has an open button too. bb's Maximize pane button gives the log the whole window.
- Settings for preview sizes, whether failures open by themselves, which rows show when the log opens, and a 12- or 24-hour clock. Changes reach open panels straight away.

## How it works

The plugin loads bb's public timeline API, including nested rows, when you open the tab. It applies live deltas afterward, with at most two refresh requests a second. It does not change bb's chat markup or store thread data; only the expanded-view choice is saved on this device. If you also want bb's chat itself to stop folding finished turns, use `bb settings completed-turns <provider> flat`.

## Limits

bb truncates output above 32,000 characters and the log keeps its truncation note. Search finds text inside Markdown messages but does not highlight it there. The whole session is fetched on opening, including large threads.
